rule: DDF Value = mean of the four adjusted trade charts (CBS Sports, USA Today, FantasyPros, FantasyCalc)

methodology: Values are 'value above waivers': how much more a player is expected to produce than a freely available replacement at the same position, in the user's league (scoring, team count, superflex). The headline value (DDF Value) is the average of the four published trade charts, each adjusted to the user's league (position and bench weighting); the projection sources are an alternate version. A stale or held source is left out of the average rather than counted as zero. Full method: the site's methodology pages.
sources: Projection sources: ESPN, CBS rest-of-season, Razzball. Published trade charts: FantasyCalc, USA Today, FantasyPros, CBS. The get_values response lists which sources are included and excluded for the current week.
value_scale: Value is points above a replacement-level player in that league. There is no fixed maximum: read values against each other, with the top of the list setting the scale. Players the league leaves on the waiver wire are worth about 0, and a value near 0 means replacement level in that league, not worthless. Always quote the value the tool returned.
